about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company in the home improvement and retail sector in Birkirkara, for a motivated and experienced Retail Shop Supervisor to join their growing team.

You will oversee daily store operations, supervise and motivate the retail staff, keep customer service standards high and make sure the store runs smoothly — from staff schedules and sales targets to merchandising, stock levels and health and safety.
The role suits a hands-on retail professional with supervisory or team leadership experience and a customer-focused approach. It is a full-time, on-site position paying €3,000 per month.
responsibilities: Oversee daily store operations, ensuring efficiency and compliance with company policies and procedures
Supervise, motivate and support retail staff to achieve individual and team performance targets
Ensure high standards of customer service and promptly address customer enquiries, concerns and complaints
Monitor sales performance and support the achievement of store sales targets
Coordinate staff schedules, allocate daily tasks and ensure adequate staffing levels
Maintain attractive product displays, proper merchandising and overall store presentation
Monitor stock levels, assist with inventory management and coordinate stock replenishment
Ensure accurate pricing, product labelling and promotional displays
Support the training and development of team members in product knowledge and customer service
Keep the store clean, organised, safe and compliant with health and safety regulations
Assist management with operational reports, sales updates and improvement opportunities
Lead by example, supporting the team with day-to-day tasks when required
requirements: Previous experience in a retail supervisory or team leadership role
Strong leadership, organisational and people management skills
Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to handle challenging situations professionally
Good understanding of retail operations, stock management and merchandising
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Good command of English, both written and spoken
Basic computer literacy and familiarity with POS systems
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and public holidays when required
offer: Full-time employment with an established retail company
A supportive and dynamic working environment
Opportunities for professional growth and career development
The opportunity to develop your leadership skills within a growing retail business
preferred: Experience in home improvement, DIY, household goods or a similar retail environment

faq: What does the Retail Shop Supervisor job pay?
The Retail Shop Supervisor job pays €3,000 per month.
How much experience do I need?
Previous experience in a retail supervisory or team leadership role is required. Experience in home improvement, DIY or household goods retail is an advantage.
Will I need to work weekends?
Yes. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and public holidays when required is part of the role.
What does the role involve day to day?
Running daily store operations, supervising and scheduling the retail team, handling customer enquiries and complaints, and looking after merchandising, pricing and stock levels.
Is this role remote or on-site?
The role is full-time and on-site at the store in Birkirkara, Malta.
